req.title: Fetching completed tasks
req.statement: The system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states the system shall optionally filter tasks by completed status when a filter query parameter is supplied. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 6 completed tasks (ids 1,2,3,9,15,19) and 14 incomplete tasks (ids 4-8,10-14,16-18,20). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — completed=true returns exactly the 6 completed tasks with correct ids and completed=true fields; (2) positive EP — completed=false returns exactly the 14 incomplete tasks; (3) negative NEG — invalid boolean string for completed param returns HTTP 422; (4) BVA — no completed param returns all 20 tasks (boundary: filter absent vs present); (5) DT — completed=false combined with limit=1 returns exactly 1 incomplete task; (6) BVA — limit boundary at exactly 1 with completed=true returns exactly 1 completed task. Each test asserts exact counts, exact field values, and exact status codes to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 20 tasks: ids 1,2,3,9,15,19 have completed=true; ids 4-8,10-14,16-18,20 have completed=false
actions: Send GET /tasks/?completed=true to the in-process FastAPI app
expected: Response body is a JSON array of exactly 6 tasks
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from datetime import datetime

engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

from app import models
db = TestingSessionLocal()
seeds = [
    (1,'Read chapter 5','desc',True,'2025-06-01 05:04:17'),
    (2,'Book flight tickets','desc',True,'2025-05-12 18:49:00'),
    (3,'Submit expense report','desc',True,'2025-05-04 12:03:37'),
    (4,'Prepare meeting agenda','desc',False,'2025-05-19 09:37:22'),
    (5,'Write project report','desc',False,'2025-06-08 01:38:04'),
    (6,'Run unit tests',None,False,'2025-06-27 23:35:20'),
    (7,'Fix login bug','desc',False,'2025-05-22 02:41:54'),
    (8,'Prepare meeting agenda',None,False,'2025-05-19 12:54:14'),
    (9,'Pay electricity bill','desc',True,'2025-05-30 15:34:19'),
    (10,'Organize desk',None,False,'2025-05-12 08:01:17'),
    (11,'Water the plants','desc',False,'2025-06-19 04:46:45'),
    (12,'Review pull request',None,False,'2025-05-24 03:09:55'),
    (13,'Buy groceries','desc',False,'2025-05-22 02:09:44'),
    (14,'Buy groceries',None,False,'2025-06-05 15:04:15'),
    (15,'Renew gym membership',None,True,'2025-06-04 22:13:03'),
    (16,'Fix login bug','desc',False,'2025-05-15 20:23:54'),
    (17,'Call the bank',None,False,'2025-06-11 14:32:47'),
    (18,'Reply to emails',None,False,'2025-05-20 17:02:49'),
    (19,'Schedule dentist appointment',None,True,'2025-06-05 22:44:36'),
    (20,'Reply to emails','desc',False,'2025-05-29 02:08:41'),
]
for row in seeds:
    t = models.Task(id=row[0],title=row[1],description=row[2],completed=row[3],created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row[4]))
    db.add(t)
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    d = TestingSessionLocal()
    try: yield d
    finally: d.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks():
    r = client.get('/tasks/?completed=true')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.json()
    assert len(data) == 6
    ids = {t['id'] for t in data}
    assert ids == {1, 2, 3, 9, 15, 19}
    assert all(t['completed'] is True for t in data)

test_filter_completed_true_returns_only_completed_tasks()
